items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: a song I recorded with Luncford

ctx.x: There was some old songs like "Smiles" that came out and songs like that that people used to sing and relate to. In fact, a song I recorded with Luncford (unintelligible) that just got popular as a pop tune when I was a kid down there, that was "Margie", way back then. This must have been around '21, 1920 or '21. The first time I heard it was at a fair-ground. And I always loved music. Whenever I heard it I would try to remember songs, you know.
And there were many old, very old songs back there that people related to back there then. But most -- the biggest thing was blues. That was the biggest thing in the South.
